title: Simulation-based Parallel Sweeping: A New Perspective on Combinational Equivalence Checking
problem: Combinational equivalence checking (CEC) is co-NP-complete; SAT-based approaches dominate but timeout on large designs. GPU acceleration for simulation-based checking unexplored.
motivation: CEC is critical for verifying design transformations in industrial flows; speedup from modern GPUs can complement SAT approaches for hard instances.
method: Exhaustive simulation-based CEC engine using GPU parallelism: distributes simulation across GPU cores to rapidly explore test patterns, achieving 88x speedup vs CPU SAT solver on specific large cases; hybrid with ABC when simulation alone insufficient.
key_novelty: Simulation-based CEC perspective using GPU parallelism instead of SAT-based methods.
contributions: GPU-parallel simulation engine for combinational equivalence checking
88.11x speedup on large cases over ABC SAT solver
Hybrid approach combining simulation + SAT for comprehensive coverage
4.89x and 4.88x average acceleration over standalone ABC and commercial tools
limitations: Simulation approach succeeds on 4/9 large cases; SAT-hard instances still require complementary methods.
primary_theme: GPU-parallel simulation for combinational equivalence checking
